messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character turns her head from a side profile to face the camera, then raises her right hand to touch her hair before turning back into profile.","camera":"A static, medium close-up shot at eye level.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with black graphic details on the sleeves.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair styled in a high bun with a small ponytail hanging down the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a tan complexion, dark eyebrows, and glossy red lips.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit environment featuring a large glass dome structure with pink and blue lighting in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's full-body rear view with a static medium close-up of the character's face and upper body from the front. The character's blonde hair, pink top, futuristic dome background, and head/hand motion are retained, though the action now appears as a front-facing head turn and hair touch rather than the source's full-body pose progression.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial viewing direction, placement, and framing while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the initial framing exactly matches the provided reference, since the reference shows a side profile while the output starts closer to a front-facing close-up.
unexpected_changes: The character's visible action is reinterpreted from a rear full-body pose to a front-facing head turn, so the original full-body action is no longer visible.
